items.title: Amazon DynamoDB
items.description: DynamoDB mastery for DVA-C02. Covers partition keys, sort keys, GSI vs LSI, read/write capacity modes, DynamoDB Streams, DAX, TTL, transactions, and the most common exam scenarios and anti-patterns.

items.title: Data Consistency & Transactions
items.description: Patterns for maintaining data consistency in distributed systems including database transactions, eventual consistency, the outbox pattern, idempotency, and conflict resolution.

items.title: Database ACID Properties
items.description: A comprehensive guide to database ACID properties (Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability) for both beginners and experienced engineers.

items.title: Hibernate Transactions and Performance in Spring Apps
items.description: Deep dive into Hibernate transaction semantics, locking, N+1 diagnostics, and performance tuning in Spring applications.

items.title: Kafka Exactly-Once Semantics (EOS)
items.description: A complete guide to Kafka exactly-once semantics — delivery guarantees, idempotent producer, transactions, read_committed consumers, Kafka Streams EOS, zombie producer fencing, two-phase commit internals, and production patterns. Beginner through senior depth.

items.title: Redis Pipeline, Transactions & Lua Scripts
items.description: Deep dive into Redis pipelining for throughput optimization, MULTI/EXEC transactions, optimistic locking with WATCH, and atomic Lua scripting — with production patterns and pitfalls.

items.title: Saga Pattern (Distributed Workflows)
items.description: A deep-dive guide to the Saga Pattern, covering Orchestration vs. Choreography coordination styles, Compensating Transactions, Spring Boot code implementations, and escalation playbooks.

items.title: Spring & Spring Data JPA: Managing Transactions
items.description: A detailed explanation and senior deep dive into managing transactions in Spring Boot and Spring Data JPA, complete with real-world examples.

items.title: Transactional Outbox Pattern
items.description: A complete guide to the Transactional Outbox Pattern, solving the Dual-Write Problem, schemas, Spring Boot implementation, polling publishers (SKIP LOCKED) vs. Change Data Capture (CDC via Debezium), and comparisons.

items.title: Transactions & Concurrency Control
items.description: ACID properties, isolation levels, locking mechanisms, MVCC, deadlocks, and optimistic vs pessimistic concurrency.

items.title: Two-Phase Commit (2PC) & Three-Phase Commit (3PC)
items.description: A comprehensive guide to Two-Phase Commit (2PC) and Three-Phase Commit (3PC) synchronous protocols, diagrams, Java implementations, limitations, and failure modes.
